evals.name: orient-and-report
evals.prompt: I've got a tbaMUD/CircleMUD server running locally on localhost:4000, with a character already logged in as dummy/helloworld. Can you connect and tell me exactly where my character is right now and what the room looks like?
evals.expected_output: Establishes one persistent connection (not a fresh reconnect per command), logs in as dummy, issues a look-equivalent command, and reports back the actual room name/description/exits observed from the live server.

evals.name: explore-and-return
evals.prompt: Connect to my MUD character (tbaMUD on localhost:4000, dummy/helloworld) and explore a couple of rooms in different directions from wherever you start. Tell me what you find, then make sure you end up back where you started.
evals.expected_output: Maintains one session across multiple moves (no dropped/re-logged-in connection), correctly reports the rooms/exits actually seen, and verifiably returns to the starting room (e.g. confirmed via a final look) by reversing the path taken.

evals.name: status-and-shop
evals.prompt: Hop into my MUD (localhost:4000, tbaMUD, login dummy/helloworld), check my character's health/level/gold, and see if you can track down a shop nearby — tell me what it's selling.
evals.expected_output: Checks score/inventory/gold via the appropriate in-game commands, explores toward a shop room, and reports back the shop's actual sell listing pulled from the live server rather than a guess.
